title: Fruit Slash Frenzy
description: Swipe across flying watermelons, pineapples, and citrus in crisp arcade slicing combos—trigger multi-fruit juicy bursts while dodging sudden bombs.
controls: Press and drag rapidly across the screen to slice airborne fruits into combos while avoiding black bombs.

zh-CN.title: 疯狂切水果
zh-CN.description: 经典爆汁街机切水果狂潮：手起刀落一刀连切西瓜菠萝满屏飙汁，灵巧避开突袭炸弹刷新极限连击得分！
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕快速滑动挥出刀光切开飞起的水果，连切多个水果触发高分暴击，注意躲开黑色炸弹。
